---
name: Alpha feedback
about: Report a wrong result, a crash or a surprise from an alrunner alpha or edge build
title: ""
labels: alpha-feedback
---

A wrong result is the most useful report: a test that passes or fails in
alrunner but behaves differently on real Business Central.

**alrunner version** (output of `alrunner --version`)

**Operating system** (for example Windows 11 x64, macOS 15 arm64, Ubuntu 24.04)

**Command** (the full command line)

**What alrunner did** (outcome: passed, failed, not run with its reason, crash, or wrong output; paste the lines that matter)

**What you expected**

**Does the test pass on real Business Central?** (yes, no, or not tried)

**Can you share the AL code?** (a small app that shows the problem helps most. Do not paste secrets or customer data.)
